The swing has become an iconic image of travel around Baños. The main reason to visit is the panorama and the feeling of open space above the valley. Mountain visibility depends on cloud cover, and a visit is often combined with the Waterfall Route.

summary: Casablanca Valley lies on the wine route between Santiago and the Pacific coast. Its cool conditions

  organized around tastings and walks through the wineries.

Casco Viejo invites you to slow down. Narrow streets open onto squares, and historic churches appear behind colorful facades. The neighborhood's architecture reflects both colonial and French influences.

This historic district forms part of a UNESCO World Heritage Site. On a guided walk, visitors discover its major landmarks and history. In the six-day itinerary, the walking portion begins after lunch, following visits to Miraflores and the Biomuseo.

The Catalina Islands lie off Costa Rica's northwestern Pacific coast. Sea routes to the islands are linked to the Flamingo area. The waters around the islands differ from the deeper open ocean, so fishing trips offer a chance to explore different stretches of the coast.

Wahoo, mackerel, horse mackerel and roosterfish can be found in the waters around the islands. From the boat, visitors can take in the islands themselves and the surrounding seascape. Catalina adds a natural offshore destination to a stay in Flamingo, where a full day can be spent fishing and exploring the coastline from the water.
